name: Date
meaning: For US accounts, it uses this format: MM/DD/YYYY.

name: Type
meaning: Type: The transaction event code T-code description.

name: Currency
meaning: The ISO currency code of the row.

name: Gross
meaning: Gross: The localized gross amount of the transaction, including fees.

name: Fee
meaning: The fee on the row; most files write it as a negative amount.

name: Net
meaning: Net: The localized net amount of the transaction (typically the gross minus any fees)

name: Reference Txn ID
meaning: The parent transaction: a refund points to its sale.

name: Balance
meaning: Balance: The running available balance in the merchant's account in the transaction currency. The balance is the previous balance plus the net amount of the current activity.

name: Sales Tax
meaning: Sales Tax: The localized sales tax amount paid as part of the transaction, as reported by PayPal or the merchant

name: Balance Impact
meaning: Balance Impact: The impact of the transaction on the account balance: Debit, Credit, or Memo.

name: Hold on balance for dispute investigation (T1110)
